purpose: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-KPROBE-FOLD-A-55-V1: cell KPROBE, the centroid-key conversion probe. There is no verdict and no admission. The deliverable is a NUMBER: m, the count of the 55 rows whose intent verdict moves from wrong to gold, reported as m / 55 with a binomial CI95 (Wilson score interval, the exact Clopper-Pearson interval reported beside it), plus the reverse count -- zero by construction on this population, because every row is already intent-wrong in the comparator, reported as a LIMIT of the cell rather than as a result -- and the FOUR-WAY transition split: wrong to gold, gold to wrong, the same wrong intent, a different wrong intent, with the stay-wrong rows further split into byte-identical answer, same wrong intent in different bytes and different wrong intent. THE DELIVERY GATE: the read refuses to produce a conversion number unless the flown Perception consumption delivered the row's own gold intent boundary value id on ALL 55 rows, as the offline derivation predicts; anything less is an engineering defect, not a measurement.
quality_read_gate: No read before the complete sealed manifest, the exact ordered outputs, the native phase summary and the single successful complete official TRAIN score all exist for this cell, and before the flown delivery check agrees with the offline derivation on all 55 rows. A partial manifest is never scored and never read.
